Our tax dollars are paying for this textbook.


Karol Markowicz (@karol)

A teen cousin showed me this in her AP American Government book. Trump is similar ideologically to Hitler and Bernie Sanders is a touch off the center to the left.







— https://nitter.net/karol/status/2040258833700810893#m

President Trump’s executive order on college sports is below. Three key provisions: 1. Five years of total eligibility 2. Only “one” free transfer without sitting. 3. No players can return from pros. Goes into effect on 8/1. Common sense & solid: whitehouse.gov/presidential-…

His authority on these matters will certainly be challenged in court, but NCAA can now cite this as authority — as they did on men in women’s sports — as we wait to see if Congress can pass any legislation.

The biggest issue right now is any act by the NCAA to set rules is challenged as an antitrust violation — which is why Congress needs to pass a bill giving an antitrust exemption for rules — but it’s stronger legal ground for NCAA to cite presidential authority than its own.

The president has withheld billions of dollars in taxpayer money to many colleges and universities and many of those acts were permitted. But judges strike down everything he tries to do so I suspect there will be litigation over this too. I do think it gives NCAA cover to cite.


IseeStupidPeople (@Paranormal8ball)

You're the lawyer. Do you think this holds up in court?



— https://nitter.net/Paranormal8ball/status/2040192836306338137#m

The biggest battle is any restriction by the NCAA is sued as an antitrust violation. Which is why an antitrust exemption is needed from Congress to set rules. But citing the president’s authority here instead of the NCAA alone is certainly better for the NCAA in courts.

Sure. This is a lie. Kids and I still haven’t gotten the Covid shot to this day, thankfully, much less begged anyone for access to it. Hope this helps your day, bud.


Pad (@oldfart_007)

Clay, any comment on begging Fox executives to give you and your kids priority access to the Covid Vaccine when it came out?



— https://nitter.net/oldfart_007/status/2040192659432546387#m

Rapid Response 47 (@RapidResponse47)

Under President Trump, the federal workforce has been reduced to its smallest level since 1966 — the lowest share of the total labor force in over a century.
